## Today's Dad Joke

Why do academics give peer feedback?

<span class="fragment">Because the alternative is the feedback we deserve.</span>

## Housekeeping

> - Final Paper due Monday Dec 7

> - Exam 2 is Thursday Dec 3 — covers Chs. 7–12

## Today's Goal

> - Make real progress on your final project before exam week
> - Give and receive one round of useful feedback
> - Leave with a clearer sense of your argument

## Workshop Format

> - Meet virtually with your assigned partner
> - 10 min each: share your outline or key argument, get feedback
> - Then: 10 min to revise or plan your next steps based on what you heard

## Giving Good Feedback

> - **What's the argument?** — Can you state their main claim in one sentence? If not, that's feedback.
> - **What's the evidence?** — Is there a specific moment or example grounding the analysis?
> - **What's the concept?** — Is the theoretical framework being applied, or just named?
> - Be specific. "This is good" and "this is unclear" are equally useless.
